terra.problem: The Bible does not identify Samson as the strongest man in the Bible. Judges 16:17 also does not establish that he was a judge.
Paul tells believers to put on the armor; he does not say that every believer reading the letter gets a set.
The passage identifies spiritual forces in the heavenly realms, but does not say the fight happens where believers cannot see it.
Paul says the feet are fitted with the readiness of the gospel of peace, not simply with peace.
The joke about the other pieces of armor has no clear logic or punchline.
The statement that Moses was Israel's leader is a Bible fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
Paul says to take the sword, but does not say to swing it.
The statement that watchman is a job in the Bible needs a reference from outside this passage.
The statement that Peter was one of Jesus' apostles needs a reference from outside this passage.
The statement that Moses was Israel's leader needs a reference from outside this passage.
Saying nobody gets left out removes the qualification in Paul's last line: grace is to all who love the Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.
